title: AeroFlow workload manifest
description: Request for paved-road infrastructure (ADR-0009). Not a deployment. Unknown keys are rejected, including any raw resource, Bicep or ARM block.

modules.description: Optional exact br/platform pins in Bicep colon form (ADR-0009). Not a capability-to-module map. The only key ADR-0009 names is hosting.

hosting.description: Bicep registry pin. ADR-0009's example writes br/platform:container-app-service:x.y.z; x.y.z is a placeholder, so this pattern requires a numeric major.minor.patch. The module name is not fixed.
